_meta.why-custom: The intake log holds the original source of every message the mailbox received, and the intake-role check that guards it lives in MailIntakeController. A manifest index page reads the generic OpenRegister object endpoint, which applies the register's own permissions rather than the intake role, so it would show those originals to anyone the register lets read. That is exactly the scenario 'the log is not readable by everyone' forbids, which is why this is a custom page over the dossiq endpoint instead of an index over the schema.

pages._note: Deliberately type custom and not index. An index page reads the generic OpenRegister object endpoint, which applies the register's permissions rather than the intake role, and every entry here holds the raw original of a message somebody sent the gemeente. The role check that guards those originals lives in MailIntakeController, so the page reads the dossiq endpoint instead. It is also not a plain list: a row carries four authentication results that have to be told apart from each other, and two acts, release and not junk, that no index row offers.
